name: St. Lucia's Cathedral, Kotahena
description: St. Lucia's Cathedral, Kotahena, stands as a testament to the Catholic faith in Sri Lanka, its intricate architecture reflecting the blend of colonial and local influences. Nestled in the heart of Kotahena, this cathedral is a must-visit for history enthusiasts and those seeking spiritual solace.
activities: Explore the cathedral's interior and exterior, Learn about the history of Catholicism in Sri Lanka, Take photos of the unique architecture

name: St. Anthony's Shrine, Kochchikade
description: St. Anthony's Shrine, Kochchikade, a historic Catholic church nestled in the heart of Colombo, offers visitors a glimpse into the city's rich religious heritage. With its ornate architecture and serene ambiance, it's a must-visit for those interested in Sri Lanka's Christian culture.
activities: Prayer and Reflection, Photography, History Tour

name: Bahirawakanda Vihara (Buddha Statue viewpoint)
description: Bahirawakanda Vihara, a serene Buddhist temple overlooking the city, offers visitors a chance to meditate under the watchful gaze of Buddha statues carved into the cliffside. This unique viewpoint provides panoramic views of Colombo and its bustling streets.

name: Walavaththe Gama Inscription
description: Walavaththe Gama Inscription is a significant historical site located in the heart of Colombo, Sri Lanka, within the bustling urban landscape. Dating back to the 13th century, the inscription is a testament to the rich cultural and religious heritage of ancient Sri Lanka. It provides valuable insights into the political and social structures of the time, as well as the linguistic practices of the past. The inscription is carved on a rock face and details the land grants made by King Parakramabahu I to the village of Walavaththe Gama. Visitors can explore the surrounding area, which includes other historical structures and monuments, offering a glimpse into the architectural styles of the period. The site is a must-visit for those interested in the country's history and culture, as it encapsulates the essence of ancient governance and the values of the era. The site is easily accessible and well-maintained, making it a comfortable and informative visit for all ages.
activities: exploring, reading about history, taking photos
